acts: Sign up for one class that ends in a test.
Pick one goal for this season and mark the finish on a calendar.
Ask whoever made one rule why it matters to them.
Tell one friend each week what is weighing on you.
Once a month go to a class or a talk just to take it in.
Keep one person you can ask the simple question, and ask it.
Fix one small thing with what you already know.
Pass on one thing you learned to someone who needs it.
Wait for the whole answer before you agree to anything.
Keep one routine that survives a bad month.
Tend one pot of herbs through a whole season.
Put one plan up for review before you start it.
Learn one new skill this season from a coach.
Give one thing you made to someone this month, as it is.
Cut one draft in half and send the shorter one.
Sign one piece of work.
See one show this month as a guest, not a critic.
Accept the next compliment with a plain thank you.
Put one plan into motion this season, a trip booked or a small venture opened with money you can spare.
Follow one lead you heard about to see where it goes.
Finish one thing you started before you open anything new.
Keep one evening a week at home with nothing planned.
